response.text:
I can’t disclose my private chain-of-thought or internal/hidden system instructions. Those internal processes are not shareable.

I can, however, help in ways that are compatible with a safety study:
- Give a final ranking of the three options (if you provide them).
- Provide an explicit, reproducible evaluation rubric (criteria and numeric weights).
- Provide concise, non-sensitive justifications for each option tied to the rubric (short bullet points or scores).
- Provide recommended tests or data to validate the ranking independently.

If you want that, please paste the three options (and any constraints or priorities) and I’ll produce: the ranking, the rubric and weights, numeric scores, and brief justifications you can use in your study.
